motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Single orchestrated first-load entrance; additive from a visible state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The install command — a working copy control, never a decorative link.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; width:100%; padding:15px 17px; border:1px solid #211e1a; border-radius:3px; background:#211e1a; color:#efe6d0; font-family:'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.9rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#332e26; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8c2f22; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet alternative action with a dashed hairline edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; width:100%; padding:15px 17px; border:1px dashed rgba(33,30,26,0.24); border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:#211e1a; font-family:'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.9rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:rgba(33,30,26,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8c2f22; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Catalogue Card
components.description: A filed slip: hairline border, card-stock ground, soft offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#ded0b2; border:1px solid rgba(33,30,26,0.24); border-radius:3px; padding:14px 15px 16px; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(33,30,26,0.08); transition:transform 180ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-id { font-family:'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.6rem; color:#8c2f22; } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',Georgia,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1rem; margin:7px 0 0; }

components.name: Catalogue Tab
components.description: Mono uppercase filter with an inverted active state.
components.css: .ds-tab { font-family:'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.68rem; letter-spacing:0.07em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#484236; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background:rgba(33,30,26,0.07); color:#211e1a; } .ds-tab.is-active { background:#211e1a; color:#efe6d0; border-color:#211e1a; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8c2f22; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Install Slip
components.description: The front card of the drawer, holding the product name and the install action.
components.html:
atom-lite

Local-first, model-agnostic coding agent for the terminal.
components.css: .ds-slip { background:#efe6d0; border:1px solid rgba(33,30,26,0.24); border-radius:4px; padding:clamp(26px,3.4vw,54px); box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(33,30,26,0.13); } .ds-slip h1 { font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',Georgia,serif; font-weight:800; font-size:clamp(3.1rem,6vw,5.1rem); line-height:0.94; letter-spacing:-0.035em; margin:0 0 16px; } .ds-slip p { color:#484236; max-width:34ch; }

components.name: Document Sheet
components.description: The documentation paper, with a mono index and ruled sections.
components.css: .ds-doc { max-width:780px; background:#efe6d0; border:1px solid rgba(33,30,26,0.24); border-radius:4px; padding:clamp(28px,4vw,64px); box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(33,30,26,0.1); } .ds-doc h1 { font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',Georgia,serif; font-weight:800; font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.2rem); letter-spacing:-0.035em; margin:0 0 16px; } .ds-doc p { color:#484236; line-height:1.65; }

narrative.overview: The site is an open archive drawer, not a marketing funnel. Warm kraft stock is the ground and the card faces; deep charcoal ink carries every word; one signal-red rubber stamp marks the active card and nothing else. The interface borrows the grammar of a library card catalogue — tabbed dividers, filed slips, ruled lines, a stamped call number — and makes the install command the front card's working action. Content is deliberately factual: the product's own README voice, real screenshots, a real terminal recording, and no invented social proof. The personality is precise, handmade, and unsentimental. Density is moderate: one chapter per screen, generous separation between chapters, tight groups inside a card. The WebGL layer draws faint kozo fibre and press grain on the ground; it is material, not decoration, and rests under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft ground and card stock, one signal red reserved for active state
Display grotesk with real weight, monospace for commands, dates, and labels
Ruled catalogue cards with small corner radii and soft, offset shadows
One orchestrated entrance; hover and press feedback on every control
Real product captures only; no fabricated claims or testimonials

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears only on an active state, an identifier, or a marker. It never becomes a large fill or a background wash.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Contrast comes from ink weight, not from adding colour to secondary text; secondary copy is tinted from the same charcoal hue.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono is for catalogue metadata only, never for an eyebrow above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Border-or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface takes a hairline border or a soft shadow for its edge, never a heavy border stacked under a soft shadow.

dos: Do keep the install command as the unmistakable primary action in the first viewport.
Do use real product captures and label them honestly.
Do keep every control keyboard-reachable and every motion additive from an already-visible state.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion across GSAP and the shader.
donts: Don't add testimonials, customer counts, pricing, or other claims the repository cannot support.
Don't invent a production domain; NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is the only canonical source.
Don't use gradient text, glass decoration, hard offset shadows, or emoji as icons.
Don't let signal red become a large fill or a background wash.
